objectives: Use diagnostic evidence to repair an r-controlled vowel error and check transfer on fresh examples.
Explain how to identify the r-controlled vowel pattern in the complete word.
Check accuracy by rereading the whole word or sentence.
concepts: identify the r-controlled vowel pattern in the complete word
R-controlled vowel patterns are read as taught sound units.
Readers blend consonants and check the complete word for meaning.
Fresh examples test transfer beyond memorised responses.

definitions.definition: A vowel spelling whose sound is influenced by the following r.
Using letter-sound knowledge to read a written word.
Applying a learned skill to a new example.

workedExamples.prompt: Compare “farm” and “fork”. What should a reader identify?
workedExamples.solution: Identify ar in farm and or in fork, then read each whole word accurately.

workedExamples.prompt: A learner swaps ar and or when spelling. What should be checked?
workedExamples.solution: Compare the whole word with conventional spelling and practise the correct r-controlled pattern.

workedExamples.prompt: Why try a fresh example after guided practice?
workedExamples.solution: A new item checks whether the learner can use the skill independently.
